name: koneps-mcp
description: KONEPS (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_koneps_service_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_KONEPS_SERVICE_KEY
platform_mcp_koneps_service_key.description: 공공데이터포털 (data.go.kr) 일반 인증키 (Decoding) for 조달청_나라장터 입찰공고정보서비스 (dataset 15129394), issued after an 활용신청.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: 나라장터검색조건에 의한 입찰공고용역조회 (services tenders): inqryDiv=1 (공고게시일시) over the last 30 days (inqryBgnDt/inqryEndDt 'YYYYMMDDHHMM'), bidNtceNm = query (입찰공고명), presmptPrceBgn = min_budget (추정가격, KRW), bidClseExcpYn=Y (입찰마감제외여부: leave out closed bids). XML response (response.body.items.item); totalCount is text so total is null. presmptPrce (추정가격), asignBdgtAmt, ntceInsttNm (공고기관), bidNtceOrd (차수), opengDt and the spec document URLs stay in raw (numbers are strings in the XML). A portal-level error (e.g. SERVICE_KEY_IS_NOT_REGISTERED_ERROR) answers an OpenAPI_ServiceResponse document instead, so postings is empty — check raw via get_posting if in doubt.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: 입찰공고목록 정보에 대한 용역조회 with inqryDiv=2 (입찰공고번호) and bidNtceNo = id (e.g. R25BK00934017); returns the first 차수. Services tenders only (goods/works use other operations).
